description: Source code for Zephyr RTOS timer shell commands, including functions for starting, stopping, one-shot, and periodic timer operations via shell interface.

methods.name: timer_top_handler
methods.description: Handler for top timer event, releases semaphore.

methods.name: timer_alarm_handler
methods.description: Handler for alarm timer event, releases semaphore.

methods.name: cmd_timer_free_running
methods.description: Starts a timer in free running mode based on shell arguments.

methods.name: cmd_timer_oneshot
methods.description: Sets a one-shot alarm timer based on shell arguments.

methods.name: cmd_timer_periodic
methods.description: Sets a periodic timer that triggers multiple times.
